title: Exponential Bound for Enumeration Budgets
statement:
For all $a,C,c,d\in\mathbb{N}$, there exist $A,e\in\mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$,
\[a\cdot 2^{C(n+1)^c}\cdot\bigl(n+C(n+1)^c+1\bigr)^d\le A\cdot 2^{n^e}.\]
replaced:
For all constants $a, C, c, d \in \mathbb{N}$ there exist $A, e \in \mathbb{N}$
such that for every $n$,
\[
a \cdot 2^{C(n+1)^c} \cdot \bigl(n + C(n+1)^c + 1\bigr)^d \le A \cdot 2^{n^e}.
\]
